## Context / Problem

The `external LLM (live openai)` arm of the `Live External Integration` workflow failed on scheduled run 42572022074 (2026-11-08 PST) and dispatch run 42684304178 (2026-11-09 PST). In each, 2 of 37 `[plan-reviewer]` calls on `openai-responses:gpt-5.4` were rejected by OpenAI with HTTP 400 `invalid_prompt` (usage-policy flag), so the plan review degraded to `INDETERMINATE` (rebar's designed fail-closed result) and the canary failed. This keeps the workflow red and blocks `unkempt-amaranth-archerfish`.

### Root cause (established; evidence in this ticket's comments)

The rejections come from OpenAI's side; rebar's requests did not change:
- A loopback capture of all 14 first-turn Pass-1 requests the discovery canary sends gives identical full-body hashes at `c43d9336262` (green 2026-11-01), `0f409b946e4` and `872e7f6c3fd` (both red).
- 3 of 4 rejected calls in the CI usage-log artifacts have 0 completed requests: the first, fixed request was refused.
- In the same dispatch run, `test_workflow_live` sent the same requests for the same fixture plan and passed.
- The installed packages (116, incl. `openai` 2.53.0, `pydantic-ai-slim` 1.107.9) are identical between the green and red runs; 0 `invalid_prompt` in the openai arm's logs from 2026-09-07 to 2026-11-01.

rebar's handling (`CHANGE_INPUT` → `LLMInputRejectedError` → `INDETERMINATE`) is correct, so there is no rebar code defect to fix and no retry is added (a retry would hide real rejections).

## Approach

Operator decision: move the OpenAI arm off `gpt-5.4` to a newer published OpenAI model, recorded in the provider-matrix doc; if OpenAI also rejects requests on the new model, remove the openai arm from the matrix in a second change.

- Model: `gpt-5.5`. OpenAI's published catalogue (`https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/all`, read 2026-11-09) lists it active and newer than `gpt-5.4`. The pinned `pydantic-ai-slim` 1.107.9 gives `gpt-5.5` exactly the same OpenAI profile as `gpt-5.4` (reasoning model; same sampling, encrypted-reasoning and structured-output handling), so only the model id changes. GPT-6 models are rejected: the pinned library profiles them as non-reasoning (wrong request shape) and recognition needs a `pydantic-ai-slim` 2.x major upgrade. `gpt-5.6-*` is rejected: its pinned profile disagrees with upstream's current one.
- Only `frontier` and the scalar `[llm] model` move (the rejected calls are frontier `plan-reviewer` calls); `standard` (`gpt-5.4-mini`) and `trivial` (`gpt-5.4-nano`) stay.
- No config key, env var, feature flag, retry, or workflow change. The overlay already exists and is selected via the existing `REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE` pointer.
- Fallback, only if the post-merge dispatch run's openai job is again rejected with `invalid_prompt`: a second Gerrit change removes the `openai` entry from the `external-llm` matrix in `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml`, deletes `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml`, and records the removal in `docs/ci-provider-matrix.md`. The workflow edit also removes the openai `OPENAI_API_KEY` env expression and the `openai)` branch from the credential-preflight step. The matrix guard tests iterate `_arms()` and `_REQUIRED_PROVIDERS` is only anthropic and bedrock, so the test edits in `tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py` are exactly: remove `test_the_openai_arm_is_live_ready_with_its_own_credential` (reads the deleted overlay), drop the `"openai": "OPENAI_API_KEY"` entry from `_PROVIDER_KEY_ENV` (it parametrizes `test_every_api_key_expression_is_guarded_on_the_arms_provider`), and drop the `"openai": "openai-responses"` entry from `_MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER`.

Portability: the change is a provider overlay consumed by rebar's own config layering; it adds no CI-only trigger.

## Scope

- `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml`: `[llm] model` and `frontier` → `openai-responses:gpt-5.5`, comment updated.
- `.github/llm-providers/README.md`: after the 2026-08-03 verified-ids sentence, note that frontier and scalar moved to `gpt-5.5` on 2026-11-09 and that the arm's first live run confirms that id on the account.
- `docs/ci-provider-matrix.md`: new §"OpenAI arm model choice" with the decision, the rejection evidence, rejected alternatives, and the fallback.
- `docs/ci-provider-matrix.md` OpenAI cost footnote: note that its `gpt-5.4` estimate predates the move.
- Fallback change only: `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml`, `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml` (deleted), `docs/ci-provider-matrix.md`, `tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py` (the openai-overlay test and the two openai dict entries listed above).

## Testing

No new testable behaviour: this is a CI provider-overlay and documentation change. Existing guards cover it: `tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py` (overlay is provider-qualified with `openai-responses` and the arm is live-ready with its own credential) and `tests/unit/test_project_default_provider.py`. The behavioural proof is the live dispatch run.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `.github/llm-providers/openai.toml` sets `[llm] model` and `[llm.model_classes] frontier` to `openai-responses:gpt-5.5`; verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_provider_matrix.py tests/unit/test_project_default_provider.py` passing.
- [x] `docs/ci-provider-matrix.md` has a §"OpenAI arm model choice" recording the decision, the `invalid_prompt` evidence (run ids 42572022074 and 42684304178, the identical request hashes across `c43d9336262`/`0f409b946e4`/`872e7f6c3fd`), and the rejected alternatives.
- [x] `.github/llm-providers/README.md` states the 2026-11-09 move of frontier/scalar to `gpt-5.5` next to the 2026-08-03 verified-ids note.
- [x] `make verify` (Jira variables unset) exits 0 before the push.
- [x] [non-codebase] The change lands through Gerrit at `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`; change number and merged SHA recorded as a ticket comment.

- [x] [non-codebase] A `workflow_dispatch` run of `Live External Integration` on `main` after the merge shows `external LLM (live openai)` concluding `success` with no `invalid_prompt`; run id and job conclusion recorded as a ticket comment. If instead it is rejected again, the fallback change removing the openai arm lands through Gerrit and a following dispatch run shows no openai job and the remaining jobs green; both run ids recorded.
  provenance: environment=github-actions-navapbc-rebar; principal=gh-cli-authenticated-operator; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — gh run view 42939278248 (workflow_dispatch on main at 91182f96362) shows job external LLM (live openai) concluded success, 18 passed 0 failed, 0 invalid_prompt occurrences in the job log
